reviews.author: Alekhya
reviews.title: Elegant look for the Main Door
reviews.body: Its been 2 months i started using the lock, it is really good and make our life so easy to unlock the doors and secure as always. batteries are good in 2 months just 10% battery was dried and still 90% available so durability is good. Installation Technician came in just a day after i started communicating with him and very professional. not a penny been demanded after installing almost for 2 hours with the door complexity(heavy and nails were inside each row). it is value for money.

reviews.author: Dayanand
reviews.title: SL1 Atomberg lock
reviews.body: I am very happy with the product and its overall quality. It meets my expectations and works as expected. The installation experience was also excellent. The technician was highly professional, punctual, and well-mannered. He completed the installation efficiently, explained everything clearly, and ensured everything was working properly before leaving. Overall, I am very satisfied with both the product and the installation service. Highly recommended!
